newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Office sets 10 mln share offer.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Office sets 10 mln share offer.

text.p: U.S. Office Products Co said Friday it was launching the public offering of 10 million shares of its common stock at $33 a share.
Of the total, it said 8,045,331 shares are being offered by the company and 1,954,669 shares by certain of its stockholders.
It said net proceeds will be used to repay debt under its bank credit facility.
The offering is being managed by Robertson, Stephens & Co LLC, Morgan Stanley & Co Inc, Smith Barney Inc, and Lehman Brothers Inc, the office products supplier said.
